summary: Small sealed bush car park off Ford Road, no homes nearby.
reasons: Sealed bays, open to the road

drivers.seclusion: Forest on all sides; nothing but a shed-sized structure within 29 m and no houses visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed entry from Ford Road into marked bays; room for a van beside the parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Rural road beside the car park; passing vehicles do not reach the bays.
drivers.convention: Public trailhead car park; several cars parked, no vans or tents seen.

flags: Mapped gates 21 m and 48 m away on tracks, not across the car park entry
Slope about 4-6% across the pin area
Possible dawn-to-dusk use rules not visible from above
sun_shade: Mixed: a large tree shades the north bays; the rest is open, with forest to the west and south.

best_section.where: Sealed bays at the small car park just off Ford Road
